headline: Profit and revenue climb sharply year-over-year
summary_short: AngloGold Ashanti reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of 3,104 (ZA cents basis), up 27.0% y/y, with net income up 49.8% y/y and EPS up 49.2% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue rose 27.0% year-over-year (-4.1% q/q) and operating income rose 58.5% y/y (-12.7% q/q). Net income was up 49.8% y/y (-21.8% q/q) and EPS rose 49.2% y/y (-21.8% q/q). All figures are in the shard's native ZA-cents basis; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures beyond these are available from the wire feed.
